decision: Developer approved migration to unofficial exceljs-hardened 5.1.1 after compatibility and security evaluation. Five deprecated indirect packages remain accepted until the unchanged review deadline. Fork supply-chain and maintenance risks remain explicit.

deprecatedExceptions.reason: Build-time app-builder-lib -> @electron/get 3 -> global-agent 3 / roarr 2. Removing it requires a major parent-chain change or additional compatibility work. Existing version only is accepted.
Build-time ASAR 3 uses legacy glob 7, with patched minimatch 11.0.9 via the CommonJS compatibility adapter.
Legacy glob 7 dependency, used by trusted build/file patterns rather than account-controlled glob input. The upstream memory-leak/maintenance warning remains; removing it requires replacing glob 7.
exceljs-hardened -> fast-csv 4 retains this helper. Application CSV operations use the reviewed application parser/exporter.
Build-time electron-winstaller -> temp uses the legacy callback API; no arbitrary renderer deletion operation is exposed.

exceljsMaintenance.risk: Unofficial unaffiliated fork explicitly approved by the developer. Short maintenance history and supply-chain trust remain risks. Deprecated indirect helpers are not declared maintained.
controls: XLSX parsing runs in a single cancellable Node worker with a 15-second timeout and bounded V8 heap.
Before ExcelJS parsing, stream-decompressed bytes, ZIP entry count, paths and supported ZIP structure are checked.
Input is limited to 20 MiB, each expanded entry to 16 MiB and total expansion to 64 MiB.
Parsed sheets, rows, columns, cell count and returned text are bounded; locking cancels parsing.
The runtime uses the Node exceljs-hardened entrypoint; the old browser bundle is excluded from packaging.
Legacy adapter and modern official minimatch 11.0.9 remain pinned and compatibility-tested.
Run the unfiltered npm audit separately; this policy does not suppress vulnerabilities.
exceljsMaintenance.followUp: Review newly published exceljs-hardened versions and advisories before changing the pin; revisit fork maintenance and deprecated dependencies by the existing review date.

securityPatchReview.note: Same-major security patch only; the existing ExcelJS and deprecated-package maintenance acceptance and review date are unchanged.
